To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) PP2A is a BZR1-activating protein; 2) B’ subunit of PP2A interacts with and activates BZR1 through the PEST domain; 3) the B’ subunit is essential for brassinosteroid-mediated plant growth; and 4) PP2A activates BZR1 by dephosphorating it.
